notes.calibration_issue: Scores significantly below quality floors. Root cause: output truncation to 8000 chars loses 38-62% of content. Judge reports outputs as 'incomplete' and 'cut off mid-sentence' because it only sees truncated text. This is a known limitation of _MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS=8000 in DeepEvalAdapter. Scores should be interpreted as baseline measurements under current truncation constraints, not as reflections of actual agent output quality.
notes.ps_researcher_score_range: 0.270-0.755 (high variance driven by which content survives truncation)
notes.ps_architect_score_range: 0.490-0.675 (more consistent, shorter outputs lose less to truncation)
